summary: Establish Epic 176 as the provider-neutral marketplace operations integration and release gate without duplicating domain truth.

impacts.evidence: Account, capability, operation, checkpoint and reconciliation state must use authenticated organization/workspace scope and forced RLS.
The integration gate retains only bounded references, statuses, hashes and quality evidence; credentials, raw provider payloads and unnecessary PII remain excluded.
Future child-slice routes are additive OpenAPI contracts with generated SDK parity; this parent ADR does not alter existing routes.
Cross-domain orchestration must use canonical envelope, Transactional Outbox and Inbox/deduplication; no unversioned event is admitted.
Provider differences remain typed connector capabilities and runtime support states; Core does not branch on provider names.
The parent gate has no standalone migration; child slices retain expand-only, backup-gated and forced-RLS migration ownership.
Default-deny capabilities, scoped SecretProvider access, approval/policy checks and fail-closed unknown outcomes apply to marketplace writes.
Write-sensitive catalog, price, order, shipment, marking, advertising and finance actions require risk-aware approval and idempotency.
Operation references, source refs, approvals, versions, checkpoints and reconciliation findings provide append-only lineage across domains.
The full gate explicitly tests duplicate commands/events/webhooks, stale updates, replay, partial results and remote unknown outcomes.
Provider calls remain fixed connector transports with timeout, rate-limit and normalized error boundaries; caller-controlled hosts are not admitted.
Operations center must expose freshness, checkpoints, retries, DLQ, health, stale data and drift without leaking secrets.
Each child runtime can be rolled back by capability disablement and worker drain; append-only accepted facts are not destructively removed.
The acceptance gate requires deterministic connector/API tests, Docker conformance, failure recovery and separate provider live qualification.
